overview.serverTagsHint: Used in Explore for quick filters when this server is listed publicly.
overview.blurBannerDesc: Frosted overlay on the channel header (matches preview above).
overview.blurAria: Blur server banner in channel header
overview.blackoutDesc: Extra darkening on the banner image (stacked with blur).
overview.blackoutAria: Dark overlay on server banner in channel header
overview.welcomeChannelDesc: Post a system message when someone joins. Leave unset to disable.

danger.sensitive: These actions are sensitive and may be irreversible. Proceed carefully.
danger.transferDesc: Move permanent server ownership to another member. This is tied to the server itself, not a role—the new owner gains full control and you lose owner-only actions unless they transfer ownership back to you.
danger.availableOwner: Available when you are the server owner (mock preview also needs a bearer session).
danger.inviteFirst: Invite another member before you can transfer ownership.
danger.archiveDesc: Lock all channels and put the community in read-only mode.
danger.deleteBody: Permanently delete {name} and all related messages, channels, and media.
danger.transferBody: Choose a member to become the new fundamental owner of {name}. This cannot be undone from here except by the new owner transferring back.
danger.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Type {name} exactly to confirm.
